title: Horace experiment
description: Same matmul, same FLOPs on the ET-SoC-1: 38 W on zeros, 47 W on ones, 63 W on random data, every run started from the same die temperature. RTL toggle counts of the multiply-add unit predict the power of 14 patterns to 0.5 W, a thermal network turns it into the heating curve, and from a cool die predictable data also runs 25% faster.
